page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: left, a blank page with no print; right, a title page cut off at the right edge of the scan, with a large title in capitals, a line in capitals, two lines of roman type, a line of the printer's name cut off, and an imprint line below. Every visible line is given as far as it can be read.
page.notes: The left page is blank. The right page is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so most of every line is missing; only the first letters are visible, and the rest of each line is marked illegible. The large capitals at the top and the short lines suggest a title page, but the words cannot be confirmed from this scan. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. The page also has a faint oval mark on the left edge (a book-support or clip shadow), which is not printed text.
